description:
Git revision access exposes three queries only tests call, and a hand-written 50-line error clone exists because the error type is not `Clone`.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs`:

- `changed_paths_between` (`:525`), `changed_worktree_paths` (`:537`) and `inspect_pinned_target` (`:214`) are called only from `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:128-137,256,426,448,451`. Removing them leaves `parse_changed_paths` (`:897-911`), `GitRevisionError::ChangedPathsFailed` (`:45-47`) and `parse_pinned_tree_entry` (`:732-751`) unused.
- `clone_git_revision_error` (`:837-888`) and `clone_io_error` (`:890-895`) are used at `:340,363,592`.
- Two variants block `Clone`. `GitUnavailable { source: std::io::Error }` (`:27-31`) holds an `io::Error`. `InvalidPath(#[from] PathReadError)` (`:51`) holds a `PathReadError`, whose `Other(anyhow::Error)` is not `Clone` (`path_errors.rs:31`). The only producer of `InvalidPath` is `validate_repo_relative_path` (`path_errors.rs:57-74`), which yields `PathReadError::InvalidPath(String)` alone.
- `Arc<io::Error>` and a `String` payload, mapped at the two call sites (`:178,304`), make the enum derivable. Making `PathReadError` `Clone` instead would ripple into `crates/server/src/routes.rs:351-354` and about 12 constructors.

Tests that use `inspect_pinned_target` as an oracle are at `git_revision_tests.rs:118-140,240-280,405-431`. The changed-paths test is at `:434-457`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `changed_paths_between`, `changed_worktree_paths`, `inspect_pinned_target`, `parse_changed_paths`, `parse_pinned_tree_entry` and `GitRevisionError::ChangedPathsFailed` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: `GitRevisionError` derives `Clone`, and no hand-written error clone remains.
- [hard] REQ-03: Pinned-target classification tests assert expected kinds through `inspect_pinned_targets`, and the git-unavailable test asserts that every request reports `GitUnavailable`.

## Notes

No new git surface is added.
title: Trim git revision access to production queries
